hxdropdownbox.h File Reference

Detailed Description

This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit dropdown box widget API.

A dropdown box is a widget that displays the selected string within a button. Clicking on the dropdown box button opens a window with a list of selectable strings.

#define HxDropdownBoxAddItem ( a,
b,
c   )     HxListAddItem((HxList_t*)a,b,c)

Add an item to a dropdown box.

HxDropdownBoxAddItem adds a new item to a dropdown box.

An item is a null-terminated string with an optional image.

The incoming pIndex argument is the index into the array of items where the item should be inserted. If pIndex is less than 0, or if pIndex is greater than the existing number of items in the list, the new item is appended to the list. The index where the new item was inserted is returned in the outgoing pIndex.

Parameters:
pDropdownBox IN: Pointer to a dropdown box
pText IN: Null-terminated string
pIndex IN/OUT: Pointer to index where item is to be inserted
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

#define HxDropdownBoxRemoveItem ( a,
b   )     HxListRemoveItem((HxList_t*)a,b)

Remove item from a dropdown box.

HxDropdownBoxRemoveItem removes an item from a dropdown box.

HX_INVALID_ARG is returned if index is less than 0. Since the index into the array of list items is zero-based, HX_INVALID_ARG is also returned if index is greater or equal to the number of items in the list.

Parameters:
pDropdownBox IN: Pointer to a dropdown box
index IN: Index of item to be removed
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful. Returns HX_INVALID_ARG if index is invalid.

HxResult HxDropdownBoxDelete ( HxDropdownBox_t *  pDropdownBox  ) 

Delete a dropdown box widget.

HxDropdownBoxDelete deletes a dropdown box created from an earlier call to HxDropdownBoxNew.

It is not necessary to call this function when quitting the application, since the widget's parent calls this function just before the parent is deleted. HxDropdownBoxDelete only needs to be called when removing a dropdown box at runtime.

Parameters:
pDropdownBox IN: Pointer to the dropdown box to delete
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

Get the bounds of a dropdown box.

HxDropdownBoxGetBounds returns the width and height of a dropdown box window that contains the specified number of strings.

The (x,y) origin of the bounds must be initialized by the application before it is passed to HxDropdownBoxNew.

Parameters:
hText IN: Pointer to the array of strings
count IN: Number of strings to measure
pBounds OUT: Pointer to bounds
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

HxResult HxDropdownBoxNew ( uint32_t  id,
HxWidget_t *  pParent,
const HxRectangle_t *  pRect,
const char *const *  hText,
int32_t  count,
HxDropdownBox_t **  hDropdownBox 
)

Create a dropdown box widget.

HxDropdownBoxNew creates a new dropdown box widget.

The height of pRect is the maximum height of the control. Additional strings are accessed by scrolling through the list. HxDropdownBoxGetBounds can be called before creating the dropdown box in order to pass in an appropriately sized rectangle.

HxListSetColor and HxListSetFont can be used to customize the look of a dropdown box.

Parameters:
id IN: Unique ID for the widget, defined by app, or kHxWidgetAutoID to auto-generate the ID
pParent IN: Pointer to "parent" widget
pRect IN: Pointer to rectangle describing the position and size of the control
hText IN: Pointer to the array of strings
count IN: Count of strings in hText
hDropDownBox OUT: Handle to the created dropdown box, NULL on failure
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful. Returns HX_MEMORY_ERROR if memory allocation fails.

HxResult HxDropdownBoxSetMaxCount ( HxDropdownBox_t *  pDropdownBox,
int32_t  count 
)

Set number of strings to display.

HxDropdownBoxSetMaxCount sets the maximum number of strings to display in the open dropdown box. The dropdown box's window is resized accordingly. Passing kHxDropdownBoxShowMax as count will cause the dropdown box to revert to the standard behavior of showing as many choices as possible.

Parameters:
pDropdownBox IN: Pointer to the dropdown box
count IN: Maximum number of strings or kHxDropdownBoxShowMax
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

HxResult HxDropdownBoxSetSelectionCallback ( HxDropdownBox_t *  pDropdownBox,
HxListSelectionCallback  pCallback,
void *  pData 
)

Set the selection callback.

HxDropdownBoxSetSelectionCallback sets the selection callback that is called each time the string highlight shifts to a new string as the user scrolls through the strings in an open dropdown box. It is also called when the dropdown box is closed.

The callback prototype is defined in hxlist.h.

Parameters:
pDropdownBox IN: Pointer to the dropdown box
pCallback IN: Callback function
pData IN: App data passed as argument to callback
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.
